summary: v1.1 end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests pass (extended suite covers v1.0 + new account_groups CRUD with delete-blocking, accounts CRUD with group validation, journal double-entry validation/voucher_no J00001, bills with DOS fields (gp_no, truck_no, s_date, payment_cond, bag_pack, weight, wb) AND backward compatibility, settings default FY 2026-04-01..2027-03-31, backup with all 8 collections, restore round-trip preserving users, auth required on all v1.1 endpoints). Frontend: login works (admin@galla.com/admin123), sidebar has 3 sections (Operations/Setup/Maintenance) with keyboard shortcut letters (M,C,D,E,F,G,A,B,P,I,H,J), new routes /account-groups (13 seeded), /accounts (2 seeded - Cash + Bank A/C), /journal (modal validates unbalanced -> keeps open; balanced 100/100 -> saved as J00001 with toast), /backup (download triggers galla-bahi-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json, restore upload UI present), /settings (firm_name + FY dates + current_date render). Purchase Entry modal has all DOS fields (s-date, gp-no, truck-no, bag_pack, weight, wb) with correct data-testid attributes.

minor.issue: _next_bill_no still uses count_documents (not race-safe) - carry-over from v1.0
voucher_no uses count_documents({}) - same race condition; concurrent creates could produce duplicate J00001

No validation of payload shape. If 'data' missing keys, silently keeps existing collections; if extra keys present, ignored. Acceptable but consider sanity check + atomic transaction (currently delete_many then insert_many - failure between leaves partial state)
Returns all bills/rokad/journal with no pagination - could be large for long-running businesses. Acceptable for kaccha arhat single-user.
Still no brute-force lockout (carry-over from iteration_1)

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by Emergent dev instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> for o.name. Warning only - functionally fine. Could break SSR if ever enabled.
Continues to use native <select>/<input type=date> (browser default) instead of shadcn Select/Calendar - intentional per design but inconsistent with shadcn UI library shipped in /components/ui/.
Uses window.alert() for unbalanced/zero amount (deduced from page.dialog handling). Toast would be more on-brand.

action_items: Make bill_no & voucher_no race-safe via atomic counter collection ($inc findOneAndUpdate) or unique index + retry.
Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (5 fails per 15 min).
Optional: replace window.alert in JournalEntry validation with toast for consistency.
Optional: validate /api/restore payload shape and wrap in pseudo-transaction for safety.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 793 lines. Recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, parties.py, items.py, bills.py, rokad.py, accounts.py, journal.py, backup.py, summary.py - to stay <700 lines per file.
_compute_account_balance scans ALL journal entries and rokad for each account in list_accounts -> O(N*M) - acceptable for kaccha arhat scale but flagged.
Default FY computation in get_settings uses datetime.now(utc) — fine but year boundary edge cases around Apr 1 should be tested with timezone awareness if business is non-UTC.
/api/restore replaces every collection except users; this is correct per spec but no audit log of who restored or when (only timestamp via exported_at). Consider storing a backup history doc.
All POST handlers use {'_id': 0} projection properly. New v1.1 endpoints follow the established pattern. Good consistency.
BillItem fields are backward compatible (all optional defaults 0/''). Verified with test_old_bill_format_still_works.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (extended with 16 new tests for v1.1: AccountGroups, Accounts, Journal, BillsV11, Settings, BackupRestore)
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_ prefixed parties, items, account groups, accounts, journal entries, bills. All cleaned via test_zz_cleanup teardown. One UI-saved journal entry J00001 remains (100/100 Bank A/C dr - Cash cr) for visual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.1 fully verified. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (40 tests, ~17s runtime) is comprehensive - covers seeded groups (13), seeded accounts (Cash + Bank A/C), group-with-accounts delete blocking, journal double-entry validation (unbalanced/zero rejected), bill DOS fields round-trip, backward compatibility of old bill format, settings default FY computation, backup with 8 collections, restore preserves users. Frontend has working data-testid on every interactive element. One leftover artifact: a single journal voucher J00001 was created via UI test and not deleted (no delete button tested). Run backend tests again before re-testing UI to ensure no state drift.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in v1.1. Initial pytest had one orphan assertion left over from insertion (assert data['items_count']>=6 from TestDashboard scope); removed and now 40/40 pass. Initial UI test hit a 5s timeout for /backup navigation because journal modal stayed open after the unbalanced-save validation (correct behavior). Second run used direct page.goto() per route and all v1.1 pages loaded and worked end-to-end.
